# PROCESS — cand_0009 (parent cand_0005, the current champion, val 0.604)

## Method
Fanned out 3 read-only diagnosis subagents over 23 of the 36 failing cand_0005 traces (the
zero-reward set + the 1/3 and 2/3 partials), each asked to separate a GENERAL, hidden-file-safe
prose fix from interpretation-variance / task-specific / infra. Cross-checked every surfaced
candidate against LEDGER (broke/fixed) + JOURNAL refutations before keeping any.

## Meta-signal that framed the decision
cand_0005 (0.604) is the champion; the THREE iterations after it (cand_0006/7/8) each ADDED prose
to prompt.md and each REGRESSED (-0.044, -0.022, -0.033), repeatedly breaking *borderline passers*
(56561, 50682, 45581, 42930, 35747) via variance. cand_0008 was a SINGLE additive bullet and still
broke 3 passers, fixed 0. Interpretation: the fixable clusters were harvested by the accepted
cand_0001/0003/0005; the residual 36 are dominated by interpretation-variance/infra, and any prose
ADDITION now perturbs borderline passers more than it fixes. So the bar for a kept edit this round
was raised: it must be a REAL fix, GENERALIZING, and in a LOW-PERTURBATION class (a narrowing that
aligns with an already-accepted direction), not a new behavioral axis.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = # tasks × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | safe general fix? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Interpretation-variance / underspecified layout, ordering, boundary, taxonomy, sign | 347-49, 398-14, 413-15, 577-40, 39946, 53305, 53449, 30930, 32975, 58484, 269-44, 267-18, 146-49, 250-20(edge), 32468 | The single visible file does not disambiguate the gold reading; correct edge/grouping/window semantics undeterminable | none (not KNOWLEDGE) | NO |
| 2 | Over-engineered implied text match (added normalization/tokenization the reference didn't show) | **14207** (1/3) | Agent added whitespace-strip + camelCase/sub-word tokenization to a substring lookup → false matches on hidden files | KNOWLEDGE / narrowing of the accepted "reuse the exact method" rule | **YES — kept** |
| 3 | Output-label casing (instruction-quoted vs neighbour-column) | 10281 | Agent mirrored neighbour column `"PASS"/"FAIL"` over instruction-quoted `"Pass"/"Fail"` | DECISION (casing precedence) | NO — CONTRADICTS 50486 (wants sheet casing); a global casing rule flips the pair |
| 4 | "My current formula doesn't work" → existing answer-cell formulas are the broken attempt | 50755, 55039 | Preserving them (cand_0005 EDIT 1 direction) is wrong here; but no uniform rule reproduces the expected values | conflicts w/ accepted EDIT 1 + interpretation-variance | NO |
| 5 | Array/expanding-range or full-column-recalc formulas | 55039, 32468, 50526 | dynamic/array formulas return blank; window/scale ambiguity | already covered / REFUTED to extend | NO (cand_0006 refuted extending the array caveat, -0.044) |
| 6 | Blue/colored-column detection | 49782 | counted a labelled column not the blue one | REFUTED (cand_0002 batch) | NO |
| 7 | No-op blank-row delete incl. always-populated index col | 157-4 | tested F:M incl. always-filled "Weeknumber"; also "trust shown-code range" | known-but-broken (agent ignores existing no-op signal) + risky code-vs-prose rule | NO — cand_0004 tried the index-col framing, didn't fix it; "trust shown code" contradicted by 347-49 |

## Edit kept (1; prompt.md; additive + narrowing)
| # | cluster | edit | verify-the-fix | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 (14207) | Extended the existing "reuse the exact method, don't invent a paraphrased rule" bullet with an in-line clause: when the reference method is a text lookup/match, apply each source term LITERALLY (plain case-insensitive substring/equality) and do NOT add whitespace-strip, stemming, abbreviation-expansion, or sub-word/camelCase tokenization the reference doesn't show. | 14207 trace: agent added whitespace-normalization ("Real Time"↔"Realtime") + token expansion → matched extra/fewer A rows → 1/3. With this clause it does a plain case-insensitive substring test = the reference behavior → generalizes to all 3 files. | BOUNDED. Fires only on text-lookup/match tasks and only tells the agent to do LESS (match exactly as written). Aligned with the ACCEPTED anti-paraphrase / no-embellishment direction (cand_0003). Passing lookup/substring tasks already match literally (they pass 3/3), so no passing trajectory's artifact changes. Placed as one appended sentence — the original sentence is left intact to minimize perturbation of the volatile WRITE-GENERAL-CODE paragraph that cand_0008 regressed by editing. |

## Deliberately NOT shipped (failed a test — would be speculative breadth)
- 10281 casing rule: contradicts 50486 (a passing/known casing case) → a "prefer instruction casing" rule
  is a DECISION-class global flip that regresses the pair. Unsafe.
- 50755/55039 "existing formulas are the broken attempt": conflicts with accepted cand_0005 EDIT 1;
  the tasks are also partly interpretation-variance (no uniform positional rule reproduces expected). Unsafe.
- 55039/32468 array/window formula rules: REFUTED — cand_0006 extended the dynamic-array caveat and lost
  -0.044, breaking 5 formula-writers. Never re-test.
- 49782 blue-column detection: REFUTED (cand_0002 batch broke tasks). Never re-test.
- 157-4 index-column exclusion / "trust the shown code's range": cand_0004 tried the index-col framing
  and it did NOT fix 157-4 (net-zero batch); "trust shown code over prose" is contradicted by 347-49
  where the shown code is the buggy part. Also the agent already IGNORES the existing "no-op = re-examine"
  signal → known-but-broken (behavioral), not a knowledge gap → per system-prompt SKILL, more prose
  won't fix it. Unsafe/ineffective.
- Multiple additive edits in one candidate: cand_0006/7/8 show each addition breaks ~3 borderline
  passers; stacking speculative bullets maximizes regression. Shipping ONLY the one edit that passes
  all three tests is the disciplined choice — breadth here would mean shipping edits that fail SAFE/VERIFIED.

## ENVIRONMENT / non-prose-fixable — handed back (a human must fix)
- **34-5**: frozen "current month" with NO in-file worked example to calibrate the reference date; also
  the documented LibreOffice recalc sheet-rename (`SHEET1`→`SHEET1 -1`). Not prose-fixable.
- **53062 / 32468**: whole-column criteria over thousands of rows may not recalc reliably in the grader.
- The interpretation-variance tail (cluster 1) needs the GOLD reading, which is undeterminable from the
  single visible file — no general prose rule can recover it. Recommended non-prose levers: a
  deterministic post-processor (enforce recalc-safe formula rewrites / non-empty answer cells / mirror a
  demonstration sheet's conventions programmatically) — all OUT of prose scope.

## Process & features used
3 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (general-purpose) over 23 failing traces; I synthesized and
verified each candidate against LEDGER/JOURNAL. One edit applied directly to prompt.md (no worktree
merge needed). task_template.md left unchanged — the one kept fix belongs in the prompt's
reuse-the-method knowledge bullet.
